rv.q: A deeply thought-provoking play, and a fantastic inaugural event to kick off Redtwist’s Twisted Playfest, Erik Gernand’s play is one to watch.
Gernand has crafted a meat-and-potatoes debate play that gives its characters enough breathing space to make for an engaging small-town drama.
For those seeking a theater experience that challenges, provokes, and lingers in the mind, The Totality of All Things delivers in every respect.
